description: A hardy plant that purifies indoor air and thrives in low light. Perfect for beginners and busy individuals. Its upright, sword-like leaves are striking and elegant.
Known for its stunning split leaves, the Monstera is a fast-growing tropical plant that brings a dramatic, jungle vibe to any room.
With its waxy, smooth leaves that reflect sunlight, the ZZ Plant is practically indestructible and requires very little water.
Features beautiful white blooms and dark green foliage. The Peace Lily is an excellent air purifier and droops to tell you when it needs water.
A classic trailing plant with heart-shaped leaves. It grows quickly and looks beautiful cascading from shelves or hanging planters.
Famous for its large, violin-shaped leaves. It requires a bit more attention and bright, indirect light, but makes a stunning focal point.
